name: Hyperbrowser
summary: Cloud platform that gives agents hosted Chrome sessions, isolated sandboxes and a web scraping API. Sessions are controlled with Playwright or Puppeteer, and it can run HyperAgent, Browser Use or computer-use models for you.
facts: Browsers, sandboxes, Web API, hosted agents
goodFor: One vendor for browsers, sandboxes and scraping
watchOut: Credit pricing is harder to compare with per-hour rivals
Smaller company with little independent coverage
